title: Jelly Roll Morton in California
summary: Williams never saw or knew Jelly Roll Morton, though he was in California at the same time.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Yes, he told us something about the date.
Did you know Jolly Roll Morton there in O'Hanel?
I never did see him. He was in California at that same time. He was there, yeah. I never did see Jolly Roll. I often heard of him about him.

Fess says he would come there and sneak in and play on the piano in the morning there. In the morning, but he never would come back with the band. Never come around to see the band. No, because I didn't know Jolly Roll.
No, I didn't know Jolly Roll.
He was in Los Angeles at that time.
